visualReview.method: Independent decoded native-pixel temporal sequences and normal gameplay screenshots; no direct video playback, physical testing or FPS guarantee.
visualReview.finding: Visible knee tuck/calf-direction change and shoulder/jersey lean/rise improve coordination. Support flex remains modest and gait remains stylised painted animation, especially at phone scale.
visualReview.attachmentAndSurfaces: Both original boots and baby/pouch or back attachment remain coherent. No sampled double hem, inverted calf, detached part or abrupt body jump.
visualReview.combat: Genuine hit/recovery followed by walking; original automatic front/back behaviour stays enabled. Native P/touch pause only after held motion prevents unattended combat during blocking export; resumed native recovery is verified.
visualReview.limits: Phone knee detail is only a few pixels. Exact south still has existing long help text crossing child area. Concurrent encoder/host intervals do not establish smoothness or FPS.
